summary: PostgreSQL 18 image pin: one tested PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB pair, pinned by digest, with a static gate.

contributes.role: the tested image pair (tags, per-platform digests, observed versions, verification date)
offline gate (make gates): no latest, index digest on every reference, PG 18, pair rule, tag/version/data_directory consistency, staleness; checks compose files against the lock
PyYAML parse of one compose file for the gate (services, build/extends refusal, duplicate keys)
hermetic selftest and mutation proof of the gate (make selftests)
opt-in, needs Docker: starts each pinned image and compares its runtime facts with the lock; run when bumping the pair
hermetic selftest of the live verifier with a fake docker (make selftests)
